entries.designBrief: A broad ice-leaf spearhead made from two unequal cold-iron wings clasping a frosted crystal wedge. One projecting lower tine and a short transverse frost-rune collar create a memorable asymmetric partizan silhouette. Dark wrapped shaft, carved mountain-iron ferrule. Fine ice-blue rune seams within the head, restrained white-cold edge lighting, no large aura. A desirable first regional magical weapon, clearly simpler than the elite artifacts.

entries.designBrief: A compact eerie billhook, NOT a scythe: one exaggerated inward hooked cutting blade curves from a gnarled ancient-metal ferrule into a claw-shaped silver crescent. Concentrated emerald-teal light shines through the rootwork and cutting throat; the hooked physical outline must remain readable without any glow.

entries.designBrief: A brutally prestigious broad blacksteel warblade with a stepped seax-like forward point, a thick bowed spine, two deep triangular cut-outs near the hilt and a split forge-channel opening along only its lower cutting bevel. Internal crimson glow and heated scarlet-orange edge interact with charred metal, no all-over flames or generic straight longsword geometry.

entries.designBrief: An elite fantasy Highland claymore whose wide leaf-shaped dark-steel blade has a prominent central angular ice ridge rather than a conventional smooth fuller. Long downward-angled quillons terminate in squared raven-beak iron shapes, a broad frost-carved mountain-knot guard and a blocky dark pommel. entries.designBrief: A tall regal silver-and-black halberd with a sweeping heraldic banner-shaped axe blade on one side, a long three-faceted armor-piercing spear above, and a compact forked beak behind. The axes and point meet around an open royal shield-shaped sapphire reliquary. Broad polished steel faces are engraved with narrow luminous deep-blue heraldic channels and fine silver relief. entries.designBrief: A genuinely different massive northern ZWEIHANDER: a narrow-waisted, dramatically WAVY FLAMBERGE blade made of dark iron, with exactly three broad asymmetric S-shaped waves on its cutting outline. Long exposed blunt ricasso with two blocky forward parrying lugs. STRAIGHT horizontal iron crossbar guard ending in square hammer-like blocks, no curved horns, no crescent quillons. A cylindrical TWO-HANDED BLACK GRIP with a heavy octagonal iron pommel, no gemstone pommel. A concentrated icy-blue cylindrical glacial core is pinned across the ricasso, feeding irregular frozen fractures into only one of the dark blade's cutting edges. The other edge remains heavy weathered steel, making asymmetry structural. Rigid bolted mountain-iron plates, mist clinging tightly to the metal. Level70 elite magical craftsmanship. Absolutely NOT a broad leaf blade, NOT a central long column of crystals, NOT a diamond crossguard gem, NOT the Highland Claymore or Hudson sword body.

entries.designBrief: An elite savage poleaxe with a large split hooked axe wing made from three articulated black-iron blade plates; the opposite side is a brutal short angular pick, and a long diamond-shaped spear rises above. A fractured furnace-red core is visible BETWEEN pinned plates at the weapon's junction, with ember channels leading into the hooked cutting faces. Controlled crimson/orange forging light reflects from the soot-scarred black metal, no blanket flames.

entries.designBrief: A severe imperial artifact polehammer with an enormous stepped triangular anvil-head, a broad faceted obsidian striking face, and a long downward-swept needle pick on the rear. The head is constructed as interlocking blackened imperial steel terraces, dark-silver buttresses and deep violet arcane fractures around a recessed vertical void prism. Ancient imperial glyphs are structural incisions, not decorative floating runes. A thick armored shaft, weighty dark pommel and sharply defined edges create endgame status. Powerful concentrated violet light from within the head, restrained corona only near the artifact; no particle cloud.

entries.designBrief: A monumental level-100 void-forged gatehammer with a uniquely huge asymmetric crescent-shaped obsidian head. Three nested structural black-steel arcs form a broken eclipse aperture, enclosing a suspended concentrated violet void heart; one arc broadens into a massive angular striking face, the opposite ends as a long curved counter-spike. Ancient dark-silver imperial braces clamp the separated arc sections together. Thick tapering armored haft and crescent counterweight, exceptional physical construction visible without glow. Deep violet illumination from INSIDE the opening and fractures, elegant controlled corona, crisp silver-black rim highlights. Legendary quality approaching Hudson's polish, entirely different silhouette and single violet family, never rainbow.
